Snackbar

Snackbars are brief, transient messages that surface at the bottom of the screen after user-triggered actions.

JavaScript API

Create and dismiss snackbars programmatically with the framework's zak.snackbar.show(message, options).

Basic Snackbar

The default snackbar is a dark pill anchored at the bottom-center. It is shown in a static position for the preview.

File deleted
HTML
<div class="zak-snackbar">
    File deleted
</div>

Snackbar with Action Button

Add an action such as "Undo" or "Retry" using .zak-snackbar-action.

Message sent
HTML
<div class="zak-snackbar">
    Message sent
    <button class="zak-snackbar-action">Undo</button>
</div>

Snackbar with Close

Use .zak-snackbar-close to let users dismiss the snackbar manually.

New update available
HTML
<div class="zak-snackbar">
    New update available
    <button class="zak-snackbar-close" aria-label="Dismiss">&times;</button>
</div>

<script>
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-snackbar-close').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        this.closest('.zak-snackbar').remove();
    });
});
</script>

Snackbar Positions

The default position is bottom-center. Override with positioning utilities for other placements.

Bottom center (default)
Bottom end
Bottom start
HTML
/* Bottom center (default) */
.zak-snackbar { bottom: 1.5rem; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }

/* Bottom end */
.zak-snackbar { bottom: 1rem; inset-inline-end: 1rem; transform: none; }

/* Bottom start */
.zak-snackbar { bottom: 1rem; inset-inline-start: 1rem; transform: none; }

JavaScript

A small helper to show and hide snackbars with optional auto-dismiss.

HTML
var zakSnackbar = {
    show: function (message, duration, actionText, onAction) {
        var existing = document.querySelector('.zak-snackbar');
        if (existing) existing.remove();

        var el = document.createElement('div');
        el.className = 'zak-snackbar';
        el.setAttribute('role', 'status');
        el.textContent = message || '';

        if (actionText) {
            var action = document.createElement('button');
            action.className = 'zak-snackbar-action';
            action.textContent = actionText;
            action.addEventListener('click', function () {
                el.remove();
                if (onAction) onAction();
            });
            el.appendChild(action);
        }

        var close = document.createElement('button');
        close.className = 'zak-snackbar-close';
        close.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Dismiss');
        close.textContent = '\u00d7';
        close.addEventListener('click', function () { el.remove(); });
        el.appendChild(close);

        document.body.appendChild(el);

        if (duration > 0) {
            setTimeout(function () { el.remove(); }, duration);
        }
        return el;
    }
};

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-snackbar          /* Base snackbar (fixed, bottom-center) */
.zak-snackbar-action   /* Action button */
.zak-snackbar-close    /* Dismiss button */
.zak-snackbar-enter / .zak-snackbar-enter-active  /* Enter animation */

Accessibility

  • Use role="status" for snackbars that do not require immediate action.
  • Keep snackbar text short and action labels explicit (e.g., "Undo", "Retry").
  • Allow dismissal via keyboard; the close and action buttons must be focusable.
  • Auto-dismissing snackbars should not expire while they contain focus.
HTML
<div class="zak-snackbar" role="status">
    Message sent
    <button class="zak-snackbar-action">Undo</button>
    <button class="zak-snackbar-close" aria-label="Dismiss">&times;</button>
</div>
